# Volume 1 timeline

## CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised

**[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) notices [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) dressed in his best clothes driving out of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and goes to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to investigate. [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) explains that [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) has gone to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) to pick up an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) to help on the farm. Mrs. Rachel warns [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) of the dangers of adopting an unknown child before taking her leave.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P25](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0025)_

## CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised

**[Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) travels to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station expecting to pick up an orphan boy, only to discover that a young girl has been left for him instead. Unable to tell the talkative child about the mistake, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) takes her bag and offers her a ride to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in his buggy. During the initial leg of the drive, the girl talks continuously about her vivid imagination and dramatic thoughts, while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) finds himself surprisingly enjoying her conversation.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027)_

**[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) drives the orphan girl through scenic spots like the [Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue) and Barry's Pond, which she renames with imaginative titles. Along the way, she correctly identifies [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), filling [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) with dread over having to tell her about the mix-up.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P44](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0044), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P56](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0056), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P70](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P74](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0074)_

## CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) brings [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) expresses shock upon discovering she is a girl rather than the expected boy. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) breaks down in tears when she realizes she is not wanted, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) allows her to stay overnight in the east gable room. After putting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bed, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) insists on sending her back, while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) gently suggests they might keep her.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060)_

## CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and admiringly takes in the surrounding nature, though she remembers she cannot stay. She eats breakfast with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), then offers to do household chores while sharing her imaginative thoughts. After dinner, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prepares to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) to return her, while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) silently indicates his desire to keep her.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P1](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P14](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P40](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0040)_

## CHAPTER V. Anne’s History

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — During their drive along the shore road to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to tell her the facts of her life. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) recounts her upbringing as an orphan, including her time with Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) and Mrs. [Hammond](../character/hammond.md) before being sent to the asylum. Hearing Anne's history of hardship and neglect fills [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) with pity and leads her to secretly consider keeping the girl.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P8](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021)_

## CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Blewett](../character/blewett.md), [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Spencer](../character/spencer.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visit Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md) to clarify the adoption mix-up, where Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md) offers to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in as a servant. Seeing Anne's distress and disliking Mrs. Blewett's harsh nature, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hesitates and decides to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back home to consult [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). Later at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay with them, resolving to raise her properly.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P12](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031)_

## CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bed and instructs her on neatness and saying bedtime prayers. After finding out [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has never prayed, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) has her improvise a prayer, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) recites in an unorthodox manner. Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes down to the kitchen and complains to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) about Anne's lack of religious upbringing, resolving to educate her.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P1](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P4](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P21](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P28](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0028)_

## CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) have decided to let her stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) then instructs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to learn the Lord's Prayer, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) repeatedly gets distracted by her daydreams and imaginations. Eventually, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is sent to her bedroom where she finishes learning the prayer and continues daydreaming out her window.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P22](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P53](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0053)_

## CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to meet [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), but offends her with blunt remarks about her red hair and looks. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flies into a fiery rage, shouting at Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) before storming off to her bedroom. After Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) leaves in huff, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upstairs and orders her to remain in her room until she agrees to apologize.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P47](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0047)_

## CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and persuades her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) so she can leave her punishment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dramatically apologizes to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who forgives her completely and gives her flowers. As [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walk back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels a warm surge of affection for the girl despite her theatrical nature.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P50](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0050)_

## CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) shows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) three plain new dresses she made for her, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is disappointed by their lack of puffed sleeves. The following morning, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stays home with a headache, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wears a flower-garlanded hat to Sunday school alone. After returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her miserable experience in Miss Rogerson's class and her honest thoughts on the church service.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P1](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P9](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P17](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P21](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0021)_

## CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Barry](../character/barry.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for decorating her hat with wild flowers at church, but then offers to introduce her to [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). They visit [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) quickly form a deep friendship and pledge to be bosom friends forever. Returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), a delighted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her excitement with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) brings [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a gift of sweeties.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P25](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P42](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0042)_

## CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns about an upcoming Sunday-school picnic and excitedly asks [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) for permission to attend. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to bake her a picnic basket, prompting a rare, affectionate embrace from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) works on her sewing, she chatteringly details her playhouse, [Idlewild](../codex/places.md#idlewild), and her growing excitement for the picnic.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P7](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P9](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P11](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0011)_

## CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers her missing brooch caught in a black lace shawl and realizes Anne's false confession was fabricated just to be allowed to go to the picnic. Apologetic for doubting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sends her off to the event with Jerry driving, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later returns home delighted after a wonderful day.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P56](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0056), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P60](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0060), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P62](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0062), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits her mistake regarding the brooch and forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), allowing her to get ready for the Sunday school picnic after all. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home overjoyed after having a wonderful time at the picnic, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) later reflects on the incident with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P62](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0062), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P65](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0065), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P69](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0069)_

## CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school, discussing the local students and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's return. During afternoon classes, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) teases [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by pulling her braid and calling her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to smash her slate over his head. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand at the blackboard, and she refuses to accept Gilbert's apology after school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Tillie Boulter](../character/tillie-boulter.md)** — After Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) publicly punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for being late by forcing her to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), she refuses to ever return to his school. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cool off at home for a while. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is overcome with laughter when she finds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping over an imagined future scenario where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) gets married and leaves her.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P81](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0081), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P96](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0096)_

## CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) permission to invite [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) over for tea and offers them raspberry cordial. During the visit, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drinks three glasses of what they believe is cordial and suddenly feels sick and dizzy, forcing her to go home. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally served [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) three-year-old currant wine instead, causing [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to become intoxicated.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P11](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P25](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P29](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P48](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0048)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Barry](../character/barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers that Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) believes she intentionally got [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk on currant wine and refuses to let them play together anymore. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes she put the wine where the cordial should have been and tries to reason with Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md), but Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) remains unforgiving. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) personally pleads with Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) to no avail, leaving her heartbroken, while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) shows a rare moment of tenderness toward the sleeping girl.

## CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share a dramatic goodbye after Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forbids [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) from playing with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to return to school, where she is warmly welcomed by her classmates, exchanges secret notes with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and enters a fierce academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. ## CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md)** — While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is away in town, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) seeks help at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) when her little sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) falls ill with severe croup. Drawing on her past experience caring for twins, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully treats [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) through the night before the doctor arrives. The next day, Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and invites her to resume her friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) has forgiven her and invited her over to see [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) excitedly rushes out and later returns overjoyed to tell [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her wonderful afternoon visiting [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and receiving Mrs. Barry's hospitality.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P46](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0046), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Sam](../character/sam.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — After [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attend the concert and stay overnight at Diana's house, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) enjoy the performance and return to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) late at night. They run and leap onto the spare-room bed, inadvertently jumping on Diana's sleeping Great-[Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). The next day, after learning that [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) is furious and threatening to cut off Diana's music lessons, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) expresses her remorse to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P27](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P48](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0048), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P52](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0052), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P60](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0060)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — After discussing the situation with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to confess to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) for jumping onto her bed. Anne's honest explanation and charm amuse [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), persuading her to forgive [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). The two become close friends, and [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) eventually invites [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to visit her in the city.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P79](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0079), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P83](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0083), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. ## CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on spring events and marks the one-year anniversary of her arrival at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) while talking with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) asks her to fetch an apron pattern from the Barrys, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confesses that she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) imagined the spruce grove was a [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood), making her terrified to cross it in the dark. Unmoved, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forces [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk through the woods as a lesson, curing Anne's desire for haunted places.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P10](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P12](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P25](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XX. ## CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Superintendent Bell](../character/superintendent-bell.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home after emotional farewells on the last day of school and learns about the arrival of the new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife. She bonds with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) at Sunday school and helps prepare a lavish tea for the couple at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). However, when Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) taste the layer cake [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) specially baked for the occasion, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reacts in dismay to its strange taste.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. **[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decorates the tea table for the minister and his wife, but accidentally flavors her special cake with anodyne liniment instead of vanilla. Mortified by her blunder, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flees to her room in tears. Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) follows her upstairs to gently comfort her and invites her to show off her flower garden.

## CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comes home thrilled to receive an invitation to tea at the manse from Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md). After worrying about her conduct, she returns from the visit in high spirits and happily recounts the evening to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), including news that [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) has hired a new female schoolteacher.

## CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts it, falls off, and breaks her ankle. During her long recovery at home, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes how deeply she cares for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who is visited by many supportive friends and neighbors while longing to return to school.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and thrives under the guidance of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remains skeptical of the concert's value, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) offers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) his warm encouragement.

## CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

He seeks help from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who agrees to buy and sew a stylish brown dress with puffed sleeves for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed to receive the dress from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), along with a pair of slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md).

[The Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) concert takes place that evening, where Anne's recitations are a huge success. ## CHAPTER XXVII. Vanity and Vexation of Spirit

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) expecting supper, but finds the stove unlit and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) nowhere in sight. When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes upstairs, she discovers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hiding under her pillows because she dyed her red hair green using hair dye bought from a peddler. After washing fails to remove the green color, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) cuts Anne's hair off short, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect remorsefully on her vanity.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVII. Vanity and Vexation of Spirit P2](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXVII. Vanity and Vexation of Spirit P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XXVII. Vanity and Vexation of Spirit P28](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXVII. Vanity and Vexation of Spirit P36](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0036)_

## CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends re-enact a poem on a flat-bottomed boat, but the boat begins to leak, stranding [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on a bridge pile. [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rows by and rescues her, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) angrily refuses his offer of friendship. After returning home safely, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on learning another lesson, while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) quietly encourages her not to abandon all her romance.

## CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Barry](../character/barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visit [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). They spend several exciting days enjoying the fair, visiting the park, and attending a concert before Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md) drives them back home.

The girls enjoy their scenic evening drive back to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) welcome her home with a hot supper.

## CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to propose organizing an advanced class to prepare students for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination, which [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agree [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) should join. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) eagerly accepts the opportunity to study to become a teacher. When the class begins, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) faces intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and realizes she has secretly forgiven him.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return to teach the Queen's class next year, to her students' delight. At home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) packs away her books for a summer vacation, and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) praises Anne's growth and character during a visit with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

## CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys an active summer outdoors following the doctor's advice and returns to her studies in autumn with renewed vigor. As the school year progresses, she prepares intensely for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams under Miss Stacy's guidance. Meanwhile, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notices with mixed feelings how tall and mature [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has become as she turns fifteen.

## CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — After finishing school and taking her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) anxiously awaits the results at home. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes over to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the newspaper to announce that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the entire [Island](../codex/places.md#island), bringing great joy and pride to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).

## CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), American, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Evans](../character/evans.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Spencer](../character/spencer.md)** — [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress in her east gable room before driving to the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) for a benefit concert with [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md). Despite an initial wave of severe stage fright upon seeing the sophisticated crowd and high-caliber performers, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) sees [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the audience and finds the resolve to deliver a triumphant recitation, earning an encore and praise from the guests.

On the drive home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) reflect on wealth, luxury, and contentment, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) asserting that she is happy to remain herself.

## CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Frank Stockley](../character/frank-stockley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares to leave for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) and shares a heartwarming moment with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) as she tries on a new dress. After arriving in town, she starts her classes and experiences severe homesickness at her boarding house. However, visits from her [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) classmates and news about the prestigious Avery scholarship renew her spirit and ambition.

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wins the Avery Scholarship while [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal. After celebrating commencement with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), re-engaging with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), noticing Matthew's failing health, and sharing a tender, memorable evening walk with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).

## CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Martin](../character/martin.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Spencer](../character/spencer.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) collapses and dies suddenly after reading news of the bank failure. The household and community mourn, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comfort each other in their shared sorrow. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her grief with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and reminisces with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about past times and Marilla's youthful romance with John Blythe.

## CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learns from an oculist that she must give up heavy eye work or face total blindness, putting the future of [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in jeopardy. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to forfeit her college scholarship, stay at home to care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and take up a local teaching job instead. After learning [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school so she could have it, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) on her way home and they finally end their feud to become close friends.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P4](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII.
